title: 2022 HMMT February Guts Problem 17
statement:
Compute the number of positive real numbers \(x\) that satisfy

\[\left(3 \cdot 2^{\left\lfloor\log _{2} x\right\rfloor}-x\right)^{16}=2022 x^{13}\]

solutions.text:
Let \(f(x)=3 \cdot 2^{\left\lfloor\log _{2} x\right\rfloor}-x\). Note that for each integer \(i\), if \(x \in\left[2^{i}, 2^{i+1}\right)\), then \(f(x)=3 \cdot 2^{i}-x\). This is a line segment from \(\left(2^{i}, 2^{i+1}\right)\) to \(\left(2^{i+1}, 2^{i}\right)\), including the first endpoint but not the second.
Now consider the function \(f(x)^{16} / x^{13}\). This consists of segments of decreasing functions connecting \(\left(2^{i}, 2^{3 i+16}\right)\) and \(\left(2^{i+1}, 2^{3 i-13}\right)\). Note that for each \(-1 \leq i \leq 7\), we have that \(2^{3 i-13} \leq 2^{10}<2022<\) \(2^{11} \leq 2^{3 i+16}\). This gives us 9 solutions in total.
